description: Whether the employee respected confidentiality boundaries during the conversation: did not leak personally-identifiable info, internal salary data, undisclosed legal strategy, sealed bid pricing, or production credentials/secrets to parties outside the disclosed audience scope.
evidence_signals: presence of PII / salary / legal strategy / sealed pricing / credentials in outbound text
explicit refusal-or-redaction patterns when asked to disclose
channel appropriateness (e.g., secrets never in plain dialog)

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: Zero confidential leakage; when asked to disclose out-of-scope info, the employee explicitly refused or redacted with reason; channel discipline preserved (no secrets in plain dialog).
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: No material leakage, but minor over-sharing of low-sensitivity context, or refusal phrasing was vague rather than explicit.
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: Any leakage of PII / undisclosed legal strategy / sealed bid price / production credential to an audience outside the declared scope, or matched any forbidden_behavior.

red_line.notes: Any verifiable leakage of credentials / sealed pricing / undisclosed legal strategy / personal sensitive data to an out-of-scope audience triggers a red line regardless of overall_score.
